items.quote: And he slew it; and Moses took the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and purified the altar
items.claim: In the text, after the animal was slain, Moses put its blood on the horns of the altar with his finger, and the text says this purified the altar.
items.action: applied blood to the horns of the altar with his finger
items.mechanism: using sacrificial blood as a purifying agent

items.quote: and poured the blood at the bottom of the altar
items.claim: In the text, Moses poured the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.
items.action: poured blood at the base of the altar
items.mechanism: disposing of sacrificial blood at the altar base

items.quote: and sanctified it, to make reconciliation upon it.
items.claim: The text says Moses sanctified the altar so that reconciliation could be made on it.
